title: The TEST / LIVE environment of a console session
caption: __Host-vx_env cookie, sent as X-Velexis-Environment. Code: (console)/env-actions.ts, lib/permissions.ts canOpenEnvironment, lib/velexis.ts getConsoleRequest.

states.label: TEST
states.detail: Every new session and every refresh starts here. Bookings, payments and queues of `environment = 'test'`.

states.label: LIVE
states.detail: Amber shell, "LIVE environment" strip, dialogs say "… in LIVE". Only a live OTA and a role in owner, admin, agent, finance.

states.label: Live refused
states.detail: Cookie says live but the API answers `403 ENVIRONMENT_NOT_ALLOWED` (OTA back to test, role now viewer): the request runs in test, banner "Live is not available for this OTA or role", cookie reset.

transitions.label: switch to live refused: cookie stays test
role or OTA no longer allows live
